NAME: SPI master verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-SPIM-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Read the boot flash with a single-bit SPI mode-0 transfer command ...
details: Read the boot flash with a single-bit SPI mode-0 transfer: command 0x03, 24-bit address, streamed data.
implementation_note: Source: MEM §8.2

NAME: t_spim_flash_read
details: Oracle: spi_flash_model returns the programmed bytes
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, checks tagged [R-1] (lines 128-133) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 Hold one chip select asserted across command address and data ...
details: Hold one chip select asserted across command, address and data phases of a transfer.
implementation_note: Source: MEM §8.3

NAME: R-3 Two independent chip selects cs_flash_n cs_imu_n.
details: Two independent chip selects: cs_flash_n, cs_imu_n.
implementation_note: Source: PHYS [N-3.5], ADR-0008

NAME: t_spim_cs
details: Oracle: only the selected CS falls; never both
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, checks tagged [R-3] and the CS release checks (lines 136-146) - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-4 SCLK 20 MHz from pclk = 125 MHz.
details: SCLK ≤ 20 MHz from pclk = 125 MHz.
implementation_note: Source: MEM §8.2 step 3

NAME: t_spim_sclk_rate
details: Oracle: measured SCLK period ≥ 8 pclk at CLKDIV=3
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, checks [R-4] shortest SCLK half-period 32 ns and the flash-model protocol check (lines 134-135) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 Never stall the APB bus the register interface is polled.
details: Never stall the APB bus: the register interface is polled.
implementation_note: Source: AHB2APB [N-7.15]

NAME: t_spim_pready
details: Oracle: PREADY high in every cycle of every access
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, check [R-5] PREADY high in every cycle (line 199) - 1 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-6 One held level interrupt to CLIC ID 15.
details: One held, level interrupt to CLIC ID 15.
implementation_note: Source: CLIC §7.2, D-17

NAME: t_spim_irq
details: Oracle: held after a one-cycle event; cleared by W1C only
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, checks [R-6] and IRQSTAT capture (lines 159-164) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 DMA request acknowledge on channel 0 one beat per assertion.
details: DMA request/acknowledge on channel 0, one beat per assertion.
implementation_note: Source: DMA §7.3, D-21

NAME: t_spim_dma
details: Oracle: dma_req_checker sees no stuck request
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, checks tagged [R-7] incl. dma_req_checker (lines 178-196) - 7 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-8 cs_x_n high and sclk low from reset until firmware acts.
details: cs_*_n high and sclk low from reset until firmware acts.
implementation_note: Source: Board safety

NAME: t_spim_reset
details: Oracle: pins at safe idle out of reset
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv, checks tagged [R-8] (lines 114, 117) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
test_chip_flash
details: Oracle: the real Boot ROM boots an image out of the flash model
implementation_note: Status in the specification: pass. Bench: make test_chip_flash (tb/soc/tb_chip.sv, MODE=flash, boot ROM sw/bootrom/spim.c from tb/models/spi_flash_model.sv); sim/chip_flash/run.log shows the image loaded, tohost = 1 and RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_pready
details: PREADY is never deasserted: the bridge would time out (R-5)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv ([R-5] PREADY high in every cycle of every access, line 199).

NAME: a_cs_excl
details: chip selects are mutually exclusive and idle high when the engine is idle
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv ([R-3] the two chip selects are never asserted together, line 136; released after transfer, line 137).

NAME: a_cs_idle
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv ([R-8] pins at safe idle, lines 114-117; chip selects released after the transfer, line 137).

NAME: a_cs_held
details: the selected chip select stays asserted for the whole transfer (R-2)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv (flash model protocol check [R-2/R-4] CS held for the whole transfer, line 134).

NAME: a_sclk_rate
details: SCLK never exceeds 20 MHz: at least 3 pclk between edges (R-4)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv ([R-4] shortest SCLK half-period 32 ns, line 135; flash-model protocol check line 134).

NAME: a_dma_drop
details: the DMA one-beat rule (D-21)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/spi_master/tb_spim.sv ([R-7] dma_req drops on ack, drops when the FIFO empties, dma_req_checker clean; lines 185-196).
